• ComboBox/ComboBox.mdx: The primary API reference where the new readOnly prop will be declared and documented.  
• ComboBox/docs/overview.mdx: Contains the visual design specs (spacing, tokens) matching the scenario images.  
• TextInput/TextInput.mdx & TextInput/docs/overview.mdx: Show how read-only inputs are styled in the TextInput component, providing a pattern for implementing and testing the readOnly prop in Combobox.  
• Select/Select.mdx & Select/docs/overview.mdx: Since Combobox builds on Select semantics, these docs outline shared behaviors (disabled vs read-only) and markup structure to ensure the new prop integrates consistently with existing dropdown components.
1.bug_scenario:
The two provided images outline the design specification for a read-only Combobox (Dropdown) component. The first image (“Structure”) shows static spacing: 16px left padding, a 4.5rem (72px) right icon container, and 16px gap between the caret icon and the input edge. It also illustrates the read-only input field displaying placeholder or selected text, alongside non-interactive clear (×) and caret icons. The second image (“Color and typography”) specifies token usage in each state:

• No input: placeholder text uses $text-placeholder, border uses $border-strong-01, background is transparent, icons use $icon-disabled, helper text uses $text-helper.  
• Filled: selected text uses $text-primary, icons remain $icon-disabled, border and helper text follow normal styling.  

Implementing the new “readOnly” prop should render the Combobox with these exact spacing, color, typography, and icon-disabled styles while preventing user text entry.
